headline: a plan A and a plan B for every habit.
a: Big and small dumbbell standing up, green tick on the big one, blue tick on the small one.
b: The same pair lying the usual way, so they read as dumbbells at a glance.

headline: Something beats nothing.
a: A sprout in a pot under a rain cloud. You said this one looks better.
b: The same bold pot, sprout and cloud, with the sun peeking out from behind the cloud.
why: You agreed with the idea of the second pass (worst days and best days) but preferred the look of the first. The redo keeps the first pass's look and adds the sun.

headline: Four ways to plan.
a: Repeat arrows, a calendar, a pill bottle and a checklist in a straight row.
b: The same four gathered and tilted like toys, with a blue clip on the checklist.

headline: Every day counts — ideal or fallback.
a: A bowl filling up with green and blue marbles. You said this one looks better.
b: A week tray holding the same plump marbles, with the last one about to drop in.
why: Same answer as step 2: the week idea, with the look of the marbles. Six days are in, green for ideal and blue for fallback, and the seventh is on its way.

headline: Make it yours.
a: A paint pot and brush with a sun and a moon.
b: A painter's palette and brush with a sun and a moon.

headline: Gentle nudges, never nagging.
a: A bell with a feather leaning on it.
b: A bell set down on a soft cushion.

headline: Add your first habit.
a: Three pots: a seed with a plus, a shoot, a sprout.
b: One sprout pot with a small plus.
why: You said a single sprout pot would have done the job, so that is what this is. I kept a small plus because the step is about adding.
